participant_1.name: Alex
participant_1.personality: Optimistic and resilient, always looking for the silver lining in tough situations. Enjoys a balanced lifestyle and believes in the importance of mental and physical health.
participant_1.background: I am a cancer survivor. My parents were both very athletic. I got a new job just yesterday to be a life coach. I am a clean eater.
